parsed.why: No trans-specific ban, but pervasive anti-LGBT hostility, police failure and leaks, prison identity violence, and an unsolved mob killing. Same-sex law is secondary; outed visitor faces high assault and impunity risk.

Anti-Homosexuality Act with death penalty and 20-year terms, upheld; documented arrests, raids, invasive exams, mob violence and digital entrapment. State-incited targeting makes outing potentially catastrophic.

Same-sex legal, gender-identity hate-crime law and visible community, but enforcement gaps, under-reporting and anti-gender disinformation. No documented trans-specific traveler restriction; friction rather than state threat.

Strong self-ID, hate-crime and equality framework, welcoming travel record; rising dating-app ambushes and undefined hate-crime recording are real but not universal state exposure. High but not flawless safety.

No sodomy ban, but morality and debauchery laws used to harass LGBT people, state crackdown on expression, coerced closures, no trans recognition and 93% social non-acceptance. Official targeting raises outing risk.
